senses.gloss: (v. אִיסְטְבָא) a system of colonnades, colonnade with double rows, basilica (v. Sm. Ant. s. v. Basilica).
units: Pes. 13ᵇ א׳ היתה נקראת (the itst’ba of the Temple being of double rows) was called ist’vanith, v. אִסְטֵיו, סְטֵיו. Ohol. XVIII, 9 (ed. נִיּוֹת … pl.).
<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 1:4">Tosef. Sabb. I, 4</cite>; a. fr.—Pl. <cite ref="A01423"><he>אִיסְטְוָונִיּוֹת</he></cite>. Ohol. l. c., v. supra.—Tanḥ.
<cite ref="Exodus 14">Mishp. 14</cite> (ed. Bub. 6 <he>איסטוטין</he> corr. acc.). Tosef. Oh. XVIII, 12 <cite ref="A01427"><he>אִיסְטְוָנוֹת</he></cite> (prob. incorr.).
